label: champ_0260_stopper_01
text: There’s no turning back now!

label: champ_0260_system_01
text: Are you ready to face the final test of the\nChampion Assessment?

label: champ_0260_chairman_02
text: It gives me great joy that you’ve managed to\nmake it all the way to the pinnacle of the\r\nPokémon League.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_03
text: The final test is a battle against me, the Top\nChampion.\c\nTo pass, all you need to do...is win.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_04
text: But before we get started, I should apologize\nfor one thing.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_05
text: You see, I have a trait that some might say is\ninappropriate for the League Chairwoman...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_06
text: I am utterly incapable of holding back when it\ncomes to Pokémon battles.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_07
text: Maybe that’s why nobody’s passed this test\nrecently. It’s a bit of a problem, to be honest.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_08
text: But you... You might manage something\nwonderful, like Champion Nemona did.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_09
text: So, are you ready for your final test?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_10
text: I want to see the true measure of your talent![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_11
text: Such overwhelming power... Such amazing skill...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_12
text: It seems Paldea has gained another wonderful\nTrainer to be proud of.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_13
text: Congratulations. It’s my honor to call you\nChampion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_ground_01
text: “Congratulations” is right! Now I can really say\nyou’re good to go![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0260_steel_01a
text: Yaaay! You did it, mister![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0260_steel_01b
text: Yaaay! You did it, miss![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

label: champ_0260_fly_01
text: Congratulations.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: champ_0260_dragon_01
text: J-j-just ABAAAZIIING! I gan’t...I GAN’T HOLD\nID IN ANYBOOORE![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: champ_0260_ground_02
text: Oof, crying again?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_14
text: You Pokémon Trainers are the treasure of Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_15
text: And amid that treasure, Champions are the\njewels that shine brightest.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_17
text: It is now your duty to set an example for all of\nthe Trainers of Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_18
text: Now, allow me to walk you back to the entrance.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0260_chairman_19
text: I’m certain you’ll find a familiar face\nawaiting you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
